list.name: dataset
list.label: Dataset
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT dataset FROM candles_1m ORDER BY dataset

options.content:
**Binance spot · real trades · UTC**  |  Dataset: **$dataset** · Symbol: **$symbol**

**market** combines public archives and live capture; gaps stay visible. **replay-…** retains the original date, never masquerading as live. 1s candles query raw trades; 1m/5m candles use GreptimeDB Flow. CVD resets at the selected range start. Double-click or drag on a chart to inspect an interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CAST(last_value(close ORDER BY bucket) AS DOUBLE) AS price FROM candles_1m WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
SELECT sum(trade_count) AS trades FROM candles_1m WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(bucket)
SELECT CAST(sum(quote_volume) AS DOUBLE) AS notional FROM candles_1m WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(bucket)

panels.title: Live data age
panels.description: Wall-clock age of the last live event, independent of the historical time range. A growing value indicates stale data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_part('epoch',now()) - date_part('epoch',max(last_event_time)) AS age_seconds FROM ingestion WHERE dataset='market' AND symbol=${symbol:sqlstring} AND worker='live'

SELECT time,open,high,low,close,volume FROM (SELECT date_bin(CAST(${resolution:sqlstring} AS INTERVAL), event_time) AS time,
 CAST(first_value(price ORDER BY event_time,trade_id) AS DOUBLE) AS open,
 CAST(max(price) AS DOUBLE) AS high, CAST(min(price) AS DOUBLE) AS low,
 CAST(last_value(price ORDER BY event_time,trade_id) AS DOUBLE) AS close,
 CAST(sum(quantity) AS DOUBLE) AS volume,
 CAST(sum(notional) AS DOUBLE) AS quote_volume,
 count(*) AS trade_count,
 CAST(sum(CASE WHEN taker_buy THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS buy_volume
FROM trades WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ${resolution:sqlstring} = '1 second'
GROUP BY time
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin(CAST(${resolution:sqlstring} AS INTERVAL), bucket) AS time,
 CAST(first_value(open ORDER BY bucket) AS DOUBLE) AS open,
 CAST(max(high) AS DOUBLE) AS high, CAST(min(low) AS DOUBLE) AS low,
 CAST(last_value(close ORDER BY bucket) AS DOUBLE) AS close,
 CAST(sum(volume) AS DOUBLE) AS volume,
 CAST(sum(quote_volume) AS DOUBLE) AS quote_volume,
 sum(trade_count) AS trade_count,
 CAST(sum(buy_volume) AS DOUBLE) AS buy_volume
FROM candles_1m WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(bucket) AND ${resolution:sqlstring} <> '1 second'
GROUP BY time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cumulative volume delta
panels.description: Taker buy quantity minus taker sell quantity, accumulated within the selected range. This is not net capital inflow.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time,sum(2*buy_volume-volume) OVER (ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cvd FROM (SELECT date_bin(CAST(${resolution:sqlstring} AS INTERVAL), event_time) AS time,
 CAST(first_value(price ORDER BY event_time,trade_id) AS DOUBLE) AS open,
 CAST(max(price) AS DOUBLE) AS high, CAST(min(price) AS DOUBLE) AS low,
 CAST(last_value(price ORDER BY event_time,trade_id) AS DOUBLE) AS close,
 CAST(sum(quantity) AS DOUBLE) AS volume,
 CAST(sum(notional) AS DOUBLE) AS quote_volume,
 count(*) AS trade_count,
 CAST(sum(CASE WHEN taker_buy THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS buy_volume
FROM trades WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ${resolution:sqlstring} = '1 second'
GROUP BY time
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin(CAST(${resolution:sqlstring} AS INTERVAL), bucket) AS time,
 CAST(first_value(open ORDER BY bucket) AS DOUBLE) AS open,
 CAST(max(high) AS DOUBLE) AS high, CAST(min(low) AS DOUBLE) AS low,
 CAST(last_value(close ORDER BY bucket) AS DOUBLE) AS close,

SELECT CASE WHEN notional < 100 THEN '<100' WHEN notional < 1000 THEN '100–1k'
WHEN notional < 10000 THEN '1k–10k' WHEN notional < 100000 THEN '10k–100k' ELSE '100k+' END AS size_usdt,
count(*) AS trades FROM trades WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY size_usdt ORDER BY min(notional)

SELECT event_time AS time,trade_id,CAST(price AS DOUBLE) AS price,
CAST(quantity AS DOUBLE) AS quantity,CAST(notional AS DOUBLE) AS notional,
CASE WHEN taker_buy THEN 'BUY' ELSE 'SELL' END AS taker_side
FROM trades WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY notional DESC,event_time DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Submitted trades / second · last 15m
panels.description: Rows submitted successfully, including idempotent reimports. Raw trade counts are deduplicated.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 seconds',ts) AS time, worker,
sum(rows_written)/5.0 AS rows_per_second FROM ingestion
WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY time,worker ORDER BY time

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 seconds',ts) AS time,worker,max(write_ms) AS write_ms
FROM ingestion WHERE dataset = ${dataset:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND ts > now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' AND rows_written>0
GROUP BY time,worker ORDER BY time

panels.title: Collector status · latest
panels.description: Replay speed and original date appear here. Compare last_update with wall-clock time; a stopped process cannot publish its own status.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dataset,symbol,worker,max(ts) AS last_update,
last_value(state ORDER BY ts) AS state,last_value(status_text ORDER BY ts) AS status_text
FROM ingestion GROUP BY dataset,symbol,worker ORDER BY dataset,symbol,worker

panels.title: Observed live trade ID gaps · last 24h
panels.description: Discontinuities observed on the live feed; no automatic backfill. Historical imports may cover these IDs later. Empty means no gap has been observed, not proof of complete history.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts AS time,symbol,first_missing_id,last_missing_id,status_text
FROM gaps WHERE ts > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100
